content: Encrypted export: AES-GCM nonce reuse under same key is catastrophic (subkey recovery, tag forgery) — random 12-byte IV per encryption from SecureRandom, stored alongside ciphertext; PBKDF2-SHA256 needs ~600k iterations (OWASP 2026) or use Argon2id; salt random+stored; PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256 available API 26+. SAF ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT cannot overwrite: picking an existing name creates 'name (1)'; openOutputStream default mode may not truncate existing longer files — use mode 'wt' or rewrite via new document. No storage permissions needed with SAF.
